messages:
maya: Heads-up — Acme reported a streaming response that ends mid-object (missing final \u007d) and no finish_reason. They hit it twice during a billing plan swap. Repro steps and logs below.

maya: CURL we used to reproduce:
```
curl -v \ \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams?model=open-fast-4&context_id=ctx-842'
```

maya: Server sent a sequence of SSE events but connection closed after a partial JSON chunk:
```
event: message
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...","role":"assistant"}}}
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."}}]
# connection reset by peer, no final: }
```

maya: Request-id: r-0f3b9c2d; timestamps: server start 2024-04-11T18:22:30Z, disconnect 18:22:36Z. Customer says they reconnected and saw a leftover comma at resume.

marcus: suspicious — did the auth rotate during that window? if token swapped mid-stream, client might rejoin with a new connection and we could be double-sending array delimiters. any proxy like Fastly in front?

lina: quick check of edge logs for r-0f3b9c2d: we see TLS session proxied by edge-uk, and an auth refresh for that account at 18:22:35. Fastly closed a keepalive at 18:22:36 with 502-to-origin then client reconnected.

marcus: ok that matches. two races: (1) origin closed and forwarded partial buffer, (2) client rejoin inserted resume headers that our ingress didn't canonicalize, so the streaming framing got a leftover comma. can you paste the raw bytes if available?

maya: pasted raw chunk in the ticket: last bytes show ",\n" then abrupt EOF. customer lib (browser) did automatic reconnect and appended more items, leaving an unclosed object. finish_reason never emitted because final sentinel was never sent.

marcus: probable root cause: when auth rotation triggers a reconnect, the ingress path returned partial chunk and didn't emit the final sentinel event. on reconnect path we append without ensuring the previous JSON stream was closed. two fixes: ensure origin emits an explicit terminal SSE event (e.g. `event: done\ndata: {"finish_reason":"length"}`) before connection close; and make the resume protocol include a stable boundary token instead of relying on trailing commas.

lina: short-term workaround for customer: enable client-side merge that tolerates trailing commas, or disable automatic reconnect so you can do a fresh request after auth swap. also can ask their CDN to increase keepalive to avoid mid-chunk closes. sending suggested reply now.

maya: sending reply: "Thanks — we recommend turning off auto-reconnect and re-running one request after the billing swap; we also opened an internal ticket to ensure terminal event on origin close." adding :thumbsup:.

ops-bot: created ticket INF-4829 to runtime-team — patch scheduled for canary on 2024-04-13 02:00 UTC. CI job: job-8871.

marcus: I'll follow up post-canary. if anyone can triage logs for other r- IDs around that billing-swap window, ping me. :eyes:
